summary: Verified Metro 500 ENOENT bundle bug fix and ran the requested Customer app web regressions. Bundle URL returns HTTP 200 (~13.98MB JS) on both localhost:3001 and the public Expo tunnel; manifest returns 200 JSON with extra.expoClient.hostUri. Web login flow works end-to-end (demo customer -> customer-home with stat-total, reload persists session). Non-customer login (partner 9000000003 + OTP 123456) is correctly blocked with error toast and the form resets automatically to phone step; localStorage azo_token is cleared. All checks passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: customer_expo supervisor program serves the Customer Expo app on port 3001 (tunnel yjnus5m-anonymous-3001.exp.direct). If ENOENT errors recur due to stale Metro file map after node_modules change, restart with 'sudo supervisorctl restart customer_expo'. Bundle cold build ~14MB; use curl -m 300.
rca of the issue: Metro bundler kept a stale file map after node_modules mutated while server ran in CI/no-watch mode, causing ENOENT for hoist-non-react-statics/react-is/package.json and a 500 InternalError. Mitigation: clean restart of the customer_expo supervisor program rebuilt Metro's file map. Verified by 200 responses on bundle+manifest via both localhost and tunnel.
